verdict.rationale: Dagster defines assets, schedules, and sensors in Python code and YAML, so users could version them in their own source control. That is a user-side workaround, not a documented Dagster capability. The evidence has no first-party docs on versioning, reviewing, or rolling back automations, and a vague community remark about 'development branches' does not establish review or rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
